shared_elements: radial/circular symmetry vs. horizontal procession — little in common
abstract patterning of small repeated units (openwork lobes vs. fleece scales)
justification: A is a radially symmetrical toothed disc with concentric openwork rings and a central abstract/schematic motif, while B is a narrative procession of two bearded human figures leading two horned rams in profile. There are no shared creatures, objects or relationships; the only faint commonality is the use of repeated small units as surface filling (openwork lobes versus rendered fleece).
